# BITCOIN MIDDAY BRIEF

Bitcoin's holding steady at seventy-eight thousand, up a single percent over twenty-four hours—modest gains in what's clearly a cautious market. Fear and Greed sitting at thirty-three tells you everything: pure fear territory.

Here's what matters: hashrate remains robust at nine-fifty-two exahash—miners aren't capitulating despite the bearish sentiment. That's structural strength underneath the noise.

On-chain signal worth watching—mempool's elevated at sixty-two-thousa
